chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from Sulayman ibn Sufyan from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

A time will come upon the people when the one who asks the people will live and the one who remains silent will die. I said, 'So what should I do if I attain that time?' He said, 'Assist them with what is with you, and if you do not find (material means), then strive (for it).'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended conduct during times of hardship according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) describes a period of hardship where asking for help ensures survival while silence leads to death. He advises the seeker to provide assistance from their own resources, and if material means are lacking, to exert effort and strive to acquire what is needed to help others.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Suleyman Bin Sufyan, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘There would come a time period upon the people, the one who asks the people would live and the one who remains silent would die’. I said, ‘So what should I do if I were to see that time period?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Assist them (the poor) with what is with you. But if you do not find (them), then strive (for it)’.
en.sarwar: 1. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu’alla’ ibn Muhammad from Sulayman ibn Sufyan from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

a time will come when people who ask for help will survive, and those who do not ask for help will die. I then asked, ‘What shall I do if I find myself in such a time?’ He (the Imam) replied, ‘Help people by means of what you have and strive hard if you do not have anything.’”
